info.name: Salesforce Account Engagement (Pardot) API v5 Objects API

description.content:
Salesforce Account Engagement (Pardot) API v5 exposes prospects,
campaigns, lists, opportunities, emails, forms and other marketing
automation objects through a uniform `/api/v5/objects/{collection}`
pattern. Authentication is delegated to Salesforce OAuth2.
